headline_zh: 视觉前处理是当前主要计算成本；ViTPose是最大单一神经模块。现有全量流程先处理完整记录再导出指令，尚非在线实时链路。

cold_resident.limitation: different clips and load; not a paired cold/warm speedup

completed_trial.name: fuse lossless chunk cut and official CRF23 copy
completed_trial.scope: CPU video preparation; not complete end-to-end latency

future_dependencies: Official tracker selects subject by cumulative area over all chunk frames, interpolates missing tracks and runs symmetric window5 smoothing twice.
Core=60s and halo=3s: first chunk reads63s; middle chunks read66s. This is input support, not measured end-to-end latency.
normalize() processes the entire source; process() finishes every chunk and stitching before export_commands(). Thus there is no streaming first-action emission in this evaluation wrapper.
Mapper explicitly samples real context through t+0.5s. Video-preparation fusion changes none of these dependencies.
action_priorities: CPU-equivalent: fuse intermediate encode/decode; now validating, not deployed.
CPU-equivalent next: share identical get_batch decode/crop tensors between ViTPose and HMR2, with memory bounded.

Main GPU branch next when resources available: measure batch1 frame latency separately from batch16 throughput, then no-flip or smaller pose model with accuracy revalidation. No measured gain is claimed.
Online route needs persistent tracker identity, causal missing-track recovery/smoothing, bounded GVHMR windows and the already-studied causal mapper; requires separate quality validation.

whole-chunk area subject selection and interpolation/smoothing
